Coron, Palawan · Since 2015

Dive Coron's legendary wrecks

Korean-run since 2015, with PADI, SSI and TDI instructors.

On set in Coron

Trusted by film and TV crews

Dive support for SBS Law of the Jungle and the movie The Golden Holiday.

Special trips

Hidden lagoons and island escapes

Island hopping, Apo Reef and overnight trips arranged by our team.

Wreck diving

Explore wrecks from 1944

Wrecks, reefs and freediving, planned around your level.

Your dive boat

Gear up. Your boat is waiting

Share your dates and experience, and we'll plan your days on the water.

Explore the Dive Sites

Start with your kind of adventure

  • Certified divers Here for the wrecks, the reefs, or a little of both? Explore the options and share your certification and recent diving experience when you inquire. Explore Dive Trips
  • Discover Scuba Diving (DSD) Never dived before? DSD is a supervised first taste of scuba with an instructor beside you. Ask which options suit your dates. About DSD
  • Training Scuba courses from your first certification to professional levels, plus TDI training for advanced wreck and technical divers. See Scuba Courses
  • Beyond diving Looking for time above the surface too? Ask about island-hopping arrangements for your Coron stay. Explore Island Hopping

The wrecks brought you here. The details help you plan

Learn about Coron's underwater destinations, then talk with W Divers about a plan that fits your experience. Site selection depends on conditions, your training and the arrangements available for your dates.

  • Wreck DivingDive into Coron's underwater history.
  • Reef DivingMake room for Coron's reef side.
Discover Coron's Dive Sites

Our dive boats

Traditional bangka dive boats with outriggers, run by the W Divers crew.

A few names you may already know

Short introductions to some of Coron's best-known wrecks. Each guide explains what to ask before you plan a visit.

See the full dive-site directory

  • Wreck Okikawa MaruA large wreck with coral growth and abundant marine life around its structure. Read the site guide
  • Wreck AkitsushimaA seaplane tender known for its distinctive crane and machinery. Read the site guide
  • Wreck Olympia MaruA cargo wreck with an imposing underwater presence. Read the site guide
  • Wreck Kogyo MaruA cargo wreck associated with wartime construction supplies. Read the site guide
  • Wreck Teru Kaze MaruA small gunboat off East Tangat Island, shallow enough at the stern for new divers and a filming location for a Korean movie. Read the site guide
  • Wreck IrakoCoron's deepest and best-preserved wreck, for advanced divers. Read the site guide

Photos show general underwater scenes, not the specific sites.

Special trips from Coron

Longer days and overnight adventures, arranged by the W Divers team on selected dates.

See all special trips

  • Apo Reef Yacht LiveaboardA 4-night yacht liveaboard to the Philippines' largest coral reef, for up to 10 divers. See the trip
  • Dugong WatchingAn early start to meet dugongs at Dugong Point, off Calauit in northern Busuanga. See the trip
  • Deserted Island 2 Days 1 NightFive dives and a night camping on an uninhabited island, two days away from town. See the trip
  • Kyokuzan Maru Day TripA full day out to one of the region's more remote Japanese wrecks. See the trip
